# Eclipse Timekeeping

> Eclipse Timekeeping is an all-in-one timekeeping, invoicing, and workforce management SaaS by Eclipse Systems. It serves small businesses, law firms, and shift-based teams in the United States. Pricing is per seat, per month: Starter $10, Pro $18, Business $28, Legal $55. The product is headquartered in Alabama and built for U.S. small businesses with a focus on the Birmingham metro area.

## Product
- [Pricing](https://eclipsesystems.pro/pricing): All four plans with per-seat prices and feature matrix.
- [Starter Plan ($10/seat/mo)](https://eclipsesystems.pro/plans/starter): Personal and team time tracking.
- [Pro Plan ($18/seat/mo)](https://eclipsesystems.pro/plans/pro): Adds clients, projects, invoicing.
- [Business Plan ($28/seat/mo)](https://eclipsesystems.pro/plans/business): Adds shifts, swaps, chat, admin reporting.
- [Legal Plan ($55/seat/mo)](https://eclipsesystems.pro/plans/legal): Adds ABA UTBMS codes, LEDES 1998B export, matters, trust accounting.
